background_story: Knockout was a feisty duck with a penchant for aquatic plants. He lived on a serene pond surrounded by lush greenery, where he spent most of his days foraging for his favorite snacks. Among his top choices were the Lemnaceae family of plants, commonly known as duckweed. Knockout could devour an entire patch of duckweed in a single sitting, earning him his name from the other pond dwellers. His love for Lemnaceae wasn't just about taste; he had a special talent for using the plants to create intricate underwater structures. As the seasons changed, Knockout's creations would bloom with vibrant colors, attracting a variety of aquatic life to the pond. His unique hobby and passion for Lemnaceae made him a beloved figure in the pond's ecosystem.
